name: Shenzhen Leading Semiconductor Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Leading Semiconductor Industry Co., Ltd. engages in the design, research and development, production, and sale of semiconductor packaging materials, semiconductor-specific equipment, and cable polymer materials in China and internationally. The company offers stamped lead frames for conventional package types, such as SOIC, TSSOP, and SOT, as well as low-to-medium pin count QFP packages; and etched lead frames for use in QFN/DFN and high pin count, and fine-pitch QFP packages. It also provides semiconductor back-end packaging equipment, including cleaning, drying, and etching equipment; and polyolefin polymer materials for wires, cables, and optical fibers.
